name: Isis
body:
Isis is the provider of rain, keeper of the moon, and protector of Ra on his daily trek across the sky. Isis also organizes the operation of the sun, moon, and stars over time to create the seasons. As such, she is venerated as the Lady of the Heavens and the Governess of the Skies.

Isis is also called upon to comfort those mourning a lost loved one, as she loved her husband Osiris so much that she brought him back to life after he was dismembered by his brother.

Isis appears as a winged human female wearing a crown on her head in the shape of a hieroglyph. The hieroglyph corresponds to the word throne. Isis is worshiped by wives, growers who count on the rain for their crops, and sailors who rely on Isis to keep them safe on their journey across the seas.

Sky

Granted Powers: Your magic embodies all of the celestial bodies in the heavens.

Refreshing Rain (Sp)

As a standard action, you create a shower of rain in a 5-foot square. Any creature partially or fully in the square gains a number of temporary hit points equal to your cleric level. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute. At 6th level, the rain also removes the fatigued condition. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Wings of Isis (Sp)

At 8th level, as a standard action, you can conjure a pair of multi-hued wings that grant you a fly speed of 30 feet with good maneuverability. These wings last for 10 minutes. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-gentle breeze, 2nd-dust of twilight, 3rd-call lightning, 4th-wandering star motes, 5th-sky steed, 6th-moonstruck, 7thblazing rainbow, 8th-sunburst, 9th-storm of vengeance.
